title: Improve and Challenge
outcome: By the end, I can make a focused repair and challenge it with regression and order-invariance tests.
scenario: A fictional recommender excludes books at an intended including equality page limit.
given: Contract: pages<=100; highest interest; ties choose smaller ID. Old code uses pages<100.
Rows A pages100 interest5; B pages90 interest3; C pages101 interest5.

steps.label: Identify cause
steps.detail: A wrongly excluded at equality, so old code selects B.

steps.label: Focused repair
steps.detail: Replace <100 with <=100 without changing ranking or type checks.

steps.label: Expected revised result
steps.detail: A becomes eligible and wins; C remains excluded.

steps.label: Challenge repair
steps.detail: Rerun 99,100,101; invalid pages; tied scores; reversed row order.

explanation: A focused change makes the claim about what caused the error testable: the equality comparison rule caused this specific failure. Regression tests check surrounding behavior that should remain unchanged. A tie case and reversed input order are necessary because a correct boundary does not ensure deterministic selection. Log the old failure and revised replay separately.

counterfactual.change: An alternative patch simply increases the limit to 101.
counterfactual.prediction: C is wrongly admitted as well as A.
counterfactual.reason: Changing the maximum alters the contract instead of repairing its comparison.

student_task: Why are tests at both 100 and 101 needed?
teacher_answer: 100 confirms equality is accepted; 101 confirms values above the unchanged maximum remain rejected.
project_evidence: For each recommender revision, retain cause, code change, targeted test, regression results and unresolved issues.
limits: Passing a small regression suite does not prove all behavior unchanged; record the suite’s actual coverage.
review_note: New fictional case individually matched to this topic, with computations and policy traces checked. Use for supported practice; preserve the independent assessment.
